requirements.title: Complex ASINH imaginary parts are radians in the interval minus pi over two through pi over two
requirements.definition: If the ASINH result is complex, its imaginary part is expressed in radians and lies in the range -pi/2 through pi/2.

pending.asinh-complex-imaginary-part-radians: Use complex inputs with nonzero real and imaginary parts and observe AIMAG(ASINH(X)) after initializing the observed value to an out-of-range sentinel; assert only the radian range property.
pending.asinh-complex-imaginary-part-range: For representative complex X values, assert AIMAG(ASINH(X)) lies in the required closed interval with a registered pi/range helper; do not assert the real-part approximation.
